title: Raised Ladder and Training Facade Court
description: One static firefighting training-court appearance, one scene and zero new independent models. The complete published raised-ladder truck is parked at unit scale with every original deployed outrigger, road wheel, fixed nested ladder and opaque cab pane unchanged; only a whole exact half-turn and translation orient it toward a freestanding practice facade. The complete existing partly raised sectional doorway sits in a separate right-hand lower opening, retaining both curved tracks, all panels, rollers, jambs and rear tie. One connected scene-only concrete floor and tall facade provide that lower doorway opening and a separate high left window. The raised ladder tip remains visibly short of the facade and does not claim a docked climbing route; no vehicle passage through the low partly-open door is asserted. Both old objects retain full raw GLB geometry, normals, internal nodes and every per-face PBR, not extracted subparts or redrawn equipment. The deep open forecourt, ladder-facing high opening and separate door practice position differ from the earlier hydrant and hose-reel water-point bay and generic equipment-cabinet corner. No people, fire, water, rescue procedure, training effectiveness, vehicle or ladder motion, door motion, clear-path certification, human fit, structural strength, accessibility, stability or safety suitability is claimed.
